## ValueTypeConstructors interface

The value-type constructors; see [ValueTypes](./contracts.valuetypes.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ValueTypeConstructors
```

## Remarks

Every constructor except `optional` returns a [ValueType](./contracts.valuetype.md) and accepts [ValueTypeOptions](./contracts.valuetypeoptions.md)<!-- -->.
